steps.name: The organisation's own grievance cell
steps.when_to_use: First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint / docket number.

steps.name: CPGRAMS
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance remains unresolved by EPFO, lodge a public grievance on the central government portal.

note: First lodge your complaint directly with EPFO through the EPFiGMS portal or by visiting/contacting the EPFO office. If it is not resolved, escalate the issue via CPGRAMS.
notes: dropped “EPF i Grievance Management System (EPFiGMS) / EPFO”: its source is stated only by a non-official page (stablemoney.in)
